subject: [PATCH 3/8] mm/gup: split out folio grab-and-store helper

2026-11-02.patch_summary: This patch splits out a helper function, gup_grab_folio_pages(), from the follow_page_pte() function in mm/gup.c. The new helper function grabs a folio reference for multiple pages, marks them accessed and dirty if necessary, and stores them for the caller. A separate function, gup_flush_pages(), is introduced to handle cache flushes, which are left to the caller after dropping the page table lock. This change aims to improve modularity and efficiency by separating concerns at different granularities.
